identification: Officer's cross belt fitting: lion mask boss keeper with scrolled border, belcher chain and hinged-top tapered whistle, as used on colonial and British officer's cross belts. Photos show no hallmarks; metal looks white metal or plated, not clearly silver. Back of boss has replaced fittings (nut, brass part). Paper printout calls it a Victorian infantry officer's whistle. The Noble comps for the same type (NSW Military Forces lion boss, chain and whistle) are all white metal.
